description: Plan Rust crate boundaries and a careful NWAU-to-HWAU public API migration without disrupting active Rust implementation work.

included: Target Rust crate boundary plan for contracts, core, CLI, MCP, API, Python, .NET, and optional WASM surfaces.
NWAU-to-HWAU terminology migration strategy using compatibility shims and deprecation notes.
Parallel-agent guardrail that avoids broad crate renames while Rust implementation work is active.
excluded: Bulk renaming active Rust crates or source files.
Claiming that the Rust workspace has completed a public crate rename.
Publishing renamed crates or breaking NWAU compatibility aliases.

gap_register.description: Actual crate rename implementation, public API migration, and registry publication are deferred to Rust GA and package registry tracks after compatibility tests and release evidence are ready.
